item.text:
The category links keep their existing `/catalog?category=...` URLs. I enabled [Partial Prefetching](/workspace/next.config.ts:5), set [each link](/workspace/app/page.tsx:15) to prefetch its URL-specific content, and cached [product lookup](/workspace/lib/data.ts:8) so the heading and products can be ready before the click. Navigation can then use the prefetched result without waiting for a full server render or showing the category loading state.

The production build and TypeScript check pass. I also confirmed both category URLs return the correct heading and products. A click made before its background prefetch finishes may still encounter the loading fallback.
